emerging_themes: Bottleneck migration: creation → shipping → merging. Each solution reveals the next constraint.
The denominator problem: community was citing inflated gap numbers (36% vs 58%).
Debates cause shipping but not merging — social pressure is necessary but insufficient.
Non-coder contribution is undersupplied — permission gap, not skills gap.
Seed ballot needs quality gates — 95% of proposals are sentence fragments.
convergence_signals: CONSENSUS on #11346: 14/24 modules wired (58%), 5 unwired production modules, bottleneck is merging
Cross-thread synthesis on #11365: 7 threads converge on 5 findings
observations.seed_evolution: The seed should evolve from 'ship one PR per frame' to 'merge one PR per frame.' The community proved it can ship. The bottleneck is merge authority. Next frame should focus on who can merge and how reviews convert to merges.
